verdict.rationale: Llama documents function calling and 'agent-optimized inference' (llama-docs-2, llama-docs-15) and even a homepage tagline 'Multi-agent coding in your terminal' (llama-docs-12), plus broad hosting via major cloud/partner platforms (llama-docs-6, llama-comm-19), suggesting some ecosystem support for agentic use. However there is no evidence of documented, named integrations with specific coding-agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGPT, Cursor) or an official SDK/plugin spec, and the developer docs themselves were found gated behind an SSO wall (llama-supp-docs-gated), undermining discoverability. Missing for 10: concrete official SDK/plugin docs for named agent frameworks, working developer docs access, and independent confirmation of agent-framework compatibility.
